scope: Local whole-matrix regression envelope for the documented SwiftShader capture workload; not a physical GPU/mobile acceptance claim or design FPS requirement.
method: Across the eight background-off cells only, take the largest median, largest p95 and largest median absolute deviation (MAD). Median cap = max median + max MAD; p95 cap = max p95 + 2 * max MAD. Round up response caps to 50ms and presented-frame caps to 10ms. Freeze before measuring the optimized client.
metricCorrection: Primary frame latency excludes STATE_PRESENTED_PARTIAL. Recomputed from the same unoptimized off-only raw trace before measuring the optimized client; partial/dropped distributions remain visible.
